$comment: Composite TYPE registry (docs/m1/composites.md §2). CLOSED: an instance's `_composite` value must be a key under `composites`; there is no second enum. Adding/removing a type is a GRAMMAR+VOCABULARY change (axioms §0): failure log -> review first. `fields` keys are schema slots (semantic); `key` is the existing syntax key the slot projects onto ('<expose>' = a node carrying _expose, '<child>' = any named child). Descriptors: required / type (closed value type) / action{verbs,cardinality} / expose{name,type,multiple} / allowed / addressable (default true) / min,max / sensitive / derived / render. The validator (m1/validate.mjs) projects an instance onto these and emits E_COMPOSITE_* codes. Round 49: `login.submit` accepts only verb:submit (was {submit,operate}) — take that as the slot's definition, not just a migration convenience. Round 50 (ruling A): every slot carries `role` = state|field|pointer — the slot's ROLE decides how its projected key renders, NOT whether the node is a composite: `state` (the composite's declared output — an `_expose` is not a widget), `field` (an input/surface slot — `_expose` renders as a control, existing semantics), `pointer` (a structural pointer to another node — `_ref` is never drawn as a fact). Consumed by m1/axis.mjs (exposeRendersAsControl / refRendersAsFact) and shared by all three targets. This replaces the round-49 blanket "composite ⇒ _expose is state" rule and the earlier descriptive role:name/value marker.

search.intent: 一个检索框：有名称、可选默认值，向页面引入查询状态

name.note: 可访问名称；源站没有可见名称时用闭式词表兜底（D-3）

form.intent: 多字段面板：≥2 个输入字段，一次提交一起上行

fields.note: 实例自己的 _expose 字段集合（不含嵌套复合件）

state.note: 字段暴露的并集；不新增值类型

table.intent: 声明字段的数据表：行集合 + 逐行完全一致的字段键集

columns.note: 列 = 每行 _fields 的键；键集必须完全一致

identity.note: 身份列；行有名字时使用 _name/_title

login.intent: 门禁块：账号位 + 密码位 + 提交 + signed-in 状态

secret.note: 密码位的值类型是封闭值类型 secret（轮 46 语法；三张策展登录页实测均用 _expose{type:secret}）

submit.note: 唯一提交动作；只认 verb:submit（轮 49 裁定 A）。passkey/扫码/第三方入口是额外登录方式，作为命名子件各自带 _action，不是 submit 的替代形态——operate 是通用动词，放进 submit 槽会让任意被 operate 的控件冒充提交

state.note: 唯一对外状态（名字固定）

paginator.intent: 分页/继续：指向被分页集合的 _ref + 页目标或「加载更多」
